verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents official SDKs for browser, iOS, Android, Node.js plus an HTTP API for event ingestion, and a separate authenticated REST API for managing syncs/models/sources/destinations, giving AI-native builders multiple official, documented integration surfaces. Missing for 10: a publicly discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe shows 404s across candidate paths) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of SDK reliability beyond vendor docs.
